children: Synopsys, Inc. (NASDAQ:SNPS) surged after Q3 FY2026 topped expectations and FY26 revenue guidance rose to ~$9.715B, fueled by Design Automation, IP and an Ansys deal, a $2B Nvidia AI investment to embed Nvidia into SNPS tools, and early results showing autonomous debugging/verification drastically cutting cycles.
: SNPS Q3 FY2026 revenue ~$2.48B (+42% YoY); GAAP EPS $2.84, non‑GAAP EPS $3.91. Growth driven by Design Automation, IP and July 2025 Ansys deal. FY26 revenue guide raised to ~$9.715B.
: Nvidia will invest $2B in Synopsys (SNPS) to integrate Nvidia AI with Synopsys tools, speeding chip design and validation and expanding from silicon to system-level workflows.
: Synopsys (SNPS) reports early results: autonomous debugging with Microsoft cuts debug cycle time 25–40% and end-to-end autonomous verification compresses weeks of manual work into hours.
: Synopsys (SNPS) upgraded to outperform with price target raised to $560 after a turnaround year and stronger-than-expected late fiscal 2026 results, signaling a solid setup for fiscal 2027
: Synopsys (SNPS) says AI is moving from a helper to powering autonomous engineering, coordinating design, verification, simulation and system validation so engineers can focus on higher‑value tasks.
